record.paper_title: Open problems in the theory of fuzzy metric spaces
record.context_brief: Completeness/completion of the fuzzy Gromov-Prokhorov space of compact fuzzy mm-spaces.
record.original_question: For the fuzzy metric space of all compact fuzzy metric-measure spaces, equipped with the fuzzy Gromov-Prokhorov distance M_GP defined from the Prokhorov fuzzy metric on probability measures and common isometric embeddings into a fuzzy metric space, is that fuzzy metric space completable?

evidence.quote: Question 3. Is the obtained fuzzy metric space of all compact fuzzy mm-spaces separable? Is it completable?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and setup. A fuzzy metric space (in the sense of George–Veeramani) is a triple $(X,M,\ast)$, where $X$ is a nonempty set, $\ast$ is a continuous t-norm, and $M:X\times X\times(0,\infty)\to(0,1]$ satisfies, for all $x,y,z\in X$ and $s,t>0$:
(i) $M(x,y,t)>0$; (ii) $M(x,y,t)=1\iff x=y$; (iii) $M(x,y,t)=M(y,x,t)$; (iv) $M(x,y,t)\ast M(y,z,s)\le M(x,z,t+s)$; (v) $M(x,y,\cdot):(0,\infty)\to(0,1]$ is continuous. The topology induced by $M$ is generated by the open balls $B(x,r,t)=\{y:M(x,y,t)>1-r\}$.

A fuzzy metric-measure space (fuzzy mm-space) is a triple $\mathcal X=(X,M,\mu)$, where $(X,M,\ast)$ is a compact fuzzy metric space and $\mu$ is a Borel probability measure on $X$ with $\operatorname{supp}\mu=X$. Two fuzzy mm-spaces $(X,M_X,\mu_X)$ and $(Y,M_Y,\mu_Y)$ are identified if there exists a fuzzy isometry $\varphi:X\to Y$ (i.e., a bijection with $M_Y(\varphi(x),\varphi(x'),t)=M_X(x,x',t)$ for all $x,x'\in X$, $t>0$) such that $\varphi_\ast\mu_X=\mu_Y$.

Given a fuzzy metric space $(Z,M_Z,\ast)$, the Prokhorov fuzzy metric $P_{M_Z}$ on the set $\mathcal P(Z)$ of Borel probability measures on $Z$ is defined by
$$P_{M_Z}(\mu,\nu,t)=\sup\{1-\varepsilon\in(0,1]:\mu(A)\le \nu(A^{\varepsilon,t})+\varepsilon\text{ and }\nu(A)\le \mu(A^{\varepsilon,t})+\varepsilon\ \forall A\text{ Borel}\},$$
where $A^{\varepsilon,t}=\{z\in Z:\exists a\in A,\ M_Z(z,a,t)>1-\varepsilon\}$.

The fuzzy Gromov–Prokhorov distance between two compact fuzzy mm-spaces $\mathcal X$ and $\mathcal Y$ is
$$M_{GP}(\mathcal X,\mathcal Y,t)=\sup\bigl\{P_{M_Z}\bigl(\varphi_\ast\mu_X,\psi_\ast\mu_Y,t\bigr)\bigr\},$$
where the supremum is taken over all fuzzy metric spaces $(Z,M_Z,\ast)$ and all isometric embeddings $\varphi:X\hookrightarrow Z$, $\psi:Y\hookrightarrow Z$. Let $\mathfrak{FM}$ denote the resulting fuzzy metric space of (isomorphism classes of) compact fuzzy mm-spaces equipped with $M_{GP}$.

Problem. Is $(\mathfrak{FM},M_{GP},\ast)$ completable, i.e., does there exist a complete fuzzy metric space into which it embeds isometrically as a dense subspace?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a published resolution of the completability question for the fuzzy Gromov–Prokhorov space of compact fuzzy mm-spaces. Related recent work addresses completeness of the Gromov–Hausdorff fuzzy metric on compact non-Archimedean fuzzy metric spaces, but does not appear to settle the completability of the fuzzy Gromov–Prokhorov construction described here. Status appears unresolved in the available literature.

status_evidence.title: Gromov-Hausdorff compactness theorem for non-Archimedean Fuzzy Metric Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Every Cauchy sequence of compact non-Archimedean fuzzy metric spaces is convergent in the non-Archimedean Gromov-Hausdorff fuzzy metric.
status_evidence.claim: Related but distinct fuzzy Gromov–Hausdorff completeness results exist; the fuzzy GP completability question is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Topological dimension of the Gromov-Hausdorff and Gromov-Prokhorov spaces
status_evidence.claim: Recent work on classical Gromov–Prokhorov spaces does not treat the fuzzy version.
